author: Fouled
body:
BUILD TEAM!

Hey guys.. Me and Evocal decided to make a new organized team for Avicus and in the future many more servers! We hope to have a good group of people in order to carry this team on to be the best we can! We will try and provide our very own server for team builds... and many more that we do! I will be making a website soon, and many more interesting things for the team with Evocal. 
Some History
Team Nexus started out as a Build Team by me and Evocal when we decided to leave Rage INC. for some reasons we won't say..
We decided to make a new team, as we should own one.. to help Avicus grow more with maps and let others enjoy.. We started some ideas with names and such and came up with "Team Nexus" as a nice Build Team name. So this is how Team Nexus started out to be as a thing..
What we expect!
We expect the people we choose to be nice to others.. have a good attitude, trustworthy for the team and help us out by coming to team builds and such. We are looking for people, that use good aesthetics and game-play in their builds.
This is what we expect from the people who apply..
How to apply!
This is how to apply for the team..

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
So now do you want to join our team? I highly suggest you do!
Good day!
- Slicorn out

replies.body: Evo, I take no offense to you two leaving. I promised a lot out of the team, and never expected I'd get no answer from TheNexus, or any other servers other than Avicus. We personally were going no where, and I can see if that's the reason. I'm trying so hard to make it fun, but it's just not coming together. This is in all possibilities my fault, and I deeply apologize. To you, and to every member of the team. No conflicts will be created, I fully support you two. I hope you go far in your team.
